item.title: Hedge funds are a top draw in Asia as investors look beyond bonds
item.description: Hedge funds are drawing in new fans and a rush of capital from Asia, as pensions, family offices and other investors look to alternative managers to help them navigate volatile debt markets and wobbly equities.
item.dc:creator: Summer Zhen, Tom Westbrook
item.content:encoded: Hedge funds are drawing in new fans and a rush of capital from Asia, as pensions, family offices and other investors look to alternative managers to help them navigate volatile debt markets and wobbly equities. Private bankers and asset allocators told Reuters that Asian investors are increasingly seeking asset diversification compared to their usual allocations to equities and bonds. The trend is the latest pressure point for traditional long-only managers, whose performances have come under scrutiny due to volatility in markets. It also raises questions on investors' default risk-management strategy of the 60/40 allocation to stocks and fixed income. Global hedge fund assets grew by a record for any quarter in the second quarter of 2026 when they rose $409 billion to $5.6 trillion, according to data from Hedge Fund Research (HFR). At UBP, the share of hedge-fund-only mandates among its Asia-based discretionary portfolio management clients has more than tripled since end-2024, the Swiss private bank said, without providing any numbers. "US Treasuries and government bonds have become a less reliable diversifier over the last few years," said Paras Gupta, head of discretionary portfolio management Asia at UBP, adding that this has widened the role hedge funds can play in portfolios. Hedge fund performance has also held up relatively well, coinciding with a long rough patch in bond markets that has turned a safe asset supposed to hold its value into a loser in portfolios. A global hedge fund index tracked by HFR gained 12.4% in 2025, a third consecutive positive year and the best performance since 2009. The index is up another 7% year-to-date. Since the end of 2024, global stocks as measured by the MSCI world index (.MIWD00000PUS) have gained about 36% while the FTSE world government bond total return index (.FTWGBIUSDT) has fallen 7%. "We do want to bring in more on the alternative asset classes," said Rani Piputri, senior director of public investment at Danantara Investment Management, which is part of Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund and is aiming for a 5% hedge fund exposure. "Because we want to have a stable return with minimum drawdown." NEW INVESTORS, NEW DRIVERS Niall O’Sullivan, global chief investment officer at strategic adviser Marsh, said some institutional investors that did not use hedge funds before now want a roughly 10% exposure, especially to multi-strategy funds with low correlation to broader markets. Interest has come from wealth managers, family offices and big investors including Japan's defined-benefit pensions where bonds' poor performance as a diversifier has been a particular concern, said Adeline Tan, head of investments at Marsh Asia. Investors also think the extreme bifurcation — whether splitting markets between AI winners and losers or driven by geopolitical rifts — creates opportunities for long-short hedge funds to profit from price differences. "Within tech, you have semiconductors outperforming software ... (the) US is outperforming the rest of the world," said Daryl Ho, senior investment strategist at DBS Bank. Albert Yang, head of Alternative Investments for Asia at J.P. Morgan Private Bank, said hedge funds are increasingly being used as a long-term allocation to manage volatility, citing growing concerns about concentration risk in AI. To be sure, performance and the flow of investment within the hedge fund industry are widely dispersed. Yang said the shift toward hedge fund exposure was not replacing traditional portfolios, but complementing them with new strategies and resilience. Multi-strategy, macro and quantitative managers that are nimble and can generate returns independent of equity market direction have been among the biggest beneficiaries. Acadian Asset Management, a $233 billion systematic fund that collects data on tens of thousands of companies and runs strategies that aim to modestly but consistently outperform equity indexes, has seen its assets in Asia quadruple in four years. "It's been 20 years since we think we've seen this level of interest," said Kelly Young, Acadian's chief executive officer.

item.title: Las bolsas europeas suben ligeramente ante la bajada de los precios del petróleo
item.description: Las bolsas europeas subían el martes, mientras la bajada de los precios del petróleo impulsaba el interés de los inversores, aunque los valores tecnológicos se veían sometidos a presión después de que las noticias sobre los avances del fabricante chino de chips de memoria ChangXin Memory Technologies avivaran las preocupaciones sobre la intensa competencia procedente de Pekín.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas subían el martes, mientras la bajada de los precios del petróleo impulsaba el interés de los inversores, aunque los valores tecnológicos se veían sometidos a presión después de que las noticias sobre los avances del fabricante chino de chips de memoria ChangXin Memory Technologies avivaran las preocupaciones sobre la intensa competencia procedente de Pekín. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) avanzaba un 0,44%, hasta los 638,44 puntos a las 0714 GMT, mientras que el FTSE 100 de Londres (.FTSE) ganaba aproximadamente un 1%, el mejor comportamiento entre los índices regionales. Los precios del petróleo retrocedían mientras los operadores evaluaban los riesgos de suministro tras los ataques a Arabia Saudita y sopesaban la posibilidad de un aumento de los suministros de gasóleo procedentes de Rusia. El sector químico (.SX4P) subía un 2%, liderando las ganancias entre todos los sectores. El sector tecnológico (.SX8P) perdía un 1,5%, siguiendo la tendencia bajista global tras los informes sobre los avances de ChangXin (CXMT), que avivaron las preocupaciones de que China esté reduciendo la brecha tecnológica con sus rivales consolidados. "Las acciones tecnológicas lideraron la caída, en particular las de los fabricantes de chips de memoria, después de que la empresa china CXMT anunciara avances en el diseño de una DRAM de mayor densidad y sus planes de lanzar un nuevo producto de memoria para servidores este año, lo que suscitó preocupaciones sobre una mayor competencia para los productores consolidados de chips de memoria", señalaron los analistas de OCBC en una nota. Entre los valores individuales, LVMH (LVMH.PA) avanzaba ligeramente a pesar de haber registrado unas ventas en el tercer trimestre inferiores a lo esperado, debido a que el deterioro de la confianza de los consumidores en China lastró la demanda de sus marcas Louis Vuitton y Dior. Las acciones de Nokia (NOKIA.HE) retrocedían un 4,4%, después de que el fabricante finlandés de equipos de telecomunicaciones acordara vender su negocio Enterprise Campus Edge al grupo de capital riesgo Aurelius. Los inversores también estarán pendientes de los datos clave de septiembre de Alemania, la mayor economía de Europa, que se publicarán durante el día.

item.title: BlackRock cools on US stocks, turns bullish on short-dated Treasuries
item.description: The BlackRock Investment Institute said it had downgraded its view on US stocks to neutral, citing volatility around AI, and upgraded Treasuries, preferring short-term notes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The BlackRock Investment Institute said it had downgraded its view on US stocks to neutral, citing volatility around AI, and upgraded Treasuries, preferring short-term notes. The move by the research arm of the world's biggest asset manager is a notable signal of caution on US equities and a vote of confidence in Treasuries as a safe haven. Here are the details: BlackRock Investment Institute closed a "long-held US equity overweight" view, downgrading to "neutral" "to manage potential volatility around the AI buildout", said Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute (BII), Rick Reider, BlackRock CIO of fixed income and Wei Li, BlackRock global chief strategist in a note dated October 12. BII is unwinding a "US Treasury underweight" view held for most of the last six years, with the researchers turning "overweight" at the short end, where they said rate hike expectations were overdone. BII is turning neutral on longer-dated Treasuries and less negative on Japanese government debt, saying the risk-reward calculation for investing has improved.

item.title: Kim Jong-un presenta un misil capaz de alcanzar EEUU mientras Trump apunta a una posible reunión
item.description: El líder norcoreano Kim Jong-un visitó un museo de la industria de defensa en el que se exhibe un misil balístico intercontinental capaz de alcanzar Estados Unidos, mostró el martes la agencia estatal de noticias KCNA.
item.dc:creator: Joyce Lee, Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: El líder norcoreano Kim Jong-un visitó un museo de la industria de defensa en el que se exhibe un misil balístico intercontinental capaz de alcanzar Estados Unidos, mostró el martes la agencia estatal de noticias KCNA. La noticia se produjo un día después de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmara que podría reunirse con Kim durante un viaje previsto a Asia. Se espera que Trump asista a la cumbre de la Cooperación Económica Asia-Pacífico (APEC) que se celebrará en China a mediados de noviembre. Kim, acompañado por su hija, conocida como Ju-ae, y su esposa, Ri Sol-ju, asistió el domingo a la inauguración del recién inaugurado Museo de la Revolución de la Defensa, informó la KCNA. El museo exhibía armamento desarrollado bajo el liderazgo de Kim, que abarcaba desde drones hasta el misil balístico intercontinental Hwasong-20, según las fotografías de la KCNA. Una exposición situada frente al lanzador del Hwasong-20 parecía mostrar un diseño de ojivas múltiples y un mapa mundial en el que se representaban alcances que se extendían más allá del territorio continental de EEUU hasta Oriente Medio, Australia y Sudamérica, según Shin Jong-woo, secretario general del Foro de Defensa y Seguridad de Corea. "La exposición parece tener como objetivo destacar los logros del programa de desarrollo científico en materia de defensa de Kim", afirmó Shin. "Daba la impresión de ser propaganda destinada a obtener una ventaja estratégica de cara a una posible cumbre entre Corea del Norte y EEUU". Los analistas señalaron que el museo también reflejaba un esfuerzo más amplio por parte de Kim para convertir las exhibiciones de armamento de Corea del Norte en símbolos duraderos de los logros militares del régimen. "Al convertir lo que antes eran exposiciones temporales de armamento en un museo permanente, Kim está institucionalizando sus logros militares y presentando el desarrollo nuclear y de misiles de Corea del Norte como un legado completo y duradero", afirmó Lim Eul-chul, profesor del Instituto de Estudios del Lejano Oriente de la Universidad de Kyungnam. Por otra parte, Corea del Norte anunció que el lunes realizó un lanzamiento de prueba de un misil balístico táctico para confirmar la mejora técnica satisfactoria de un componente clave no especificado. La KCNA señaló que la mejora supuso un paso importante para optimizar el rendimiento de todos los sistemas de armas ofensivas, sin ofrecer más detalles. El ejército de Corea del Sur informó el lunes de que Corea del Norte había lanzado varios misiles balísticos hacia el mar frente a su costa este. Este lanzamiento fue el cuarto de Pionyang en un mes, tras la reciente prueba de un misil hipersónico realizada por Seúl.

item.title: Why Adani's Mumbai airport, airlines are at odds over flight cuts
item.description: Adani Group's Mumbai airport and airlines are sparring over plans to temporarily cut international flights to make way for the partial demolition of an ageing terminal, emails reviewed by Reuters show.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Adani Group's Mumbai airport and airlines are sparring over plans to temporarily cut international flights to make way for the partial demolition of an ageing terminal, emails reviewed by Reuters show. Here is what is at stake: WHAT IS ADANI PROPOSING? Mumbai International Airport Ltd (MIAL), run by Adani Airport Holdings, plans to start rebuilding the north section of Terminal 1B in January 2027. It says the risks of keeping the 60-year-old building open became more pronounced after a fire at Terminal 1 in April. Adani says about 5 million of the airport's roughly 55 million annual passengers will be temporarily affected. To absorb them at Terminal 2, MIAL has said it needs an equivalent temporary cut in traffic there and had proposed a 33% reduction in international departure slots, according to the emails. Adani says a rebuilt Terminal 1 will have capacity for 20 million passengers a year, up from 15 million, and that airlines' historic slots will be restored. Adani Airport Holdings, a unit of flagship Adani Enterprises, runs eight airports in India that handle more than 23% of the country's passenger traffic, the company says. WHY ARE AIRLINES PUSHING BACK? The Airline Operators Committee of Mumbai, which represents carriers, said in an October 2 letter that the proposal was "not accepted." It said winter schedules had been approved in June and there had been no meaningful consultation on the cut. In a later email, it said the cut was being proposed unilaterally and had not been agreed. Adani said it has consulted airlines on the terminal's future since 2020. A spokesperson said airlines had not rejected the plan. The committee has also asked to review independent consultant reports on the terminal's structural safety. MIAL said structural audit reports had been reviewed by regulators and extracts made public. In a March 2025 consultation paper, the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority of India said an inspection conducted through its independent consultant had found structural problems at Mumbai airport's Terminal 1, including cracks and corrosion. The committee said airlines fully support the terminal's redevelopment but warned that cutting flights at short notice could significantly disrupt international schedules, passenger bookings and connectivity from Mumbai. WHERE DOES NAVI MUMBAI FIT IN? Adani also runs the new Navi Mumbai airport, about 36 kilometres (22 miles) away, and says airlines can temporarily move operations there "at their discretion." It is offering a 100% landing fee discount on new international flights, and plans cash vouchers for international passengers to offset a difference in user development fees. The committee says airlines have not agreed to any "forced transfer" there. The standoff is an early test of Mumbai's two-airport system. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? After an October 6 meeting chaired by the civil aviation secretary, MIAL deferred cuts planned from October 25 "by a few weeks." But in an October 10 email, it said the reduction was still required and asked airlines to bring a collective proposal to achieve it to a meeting set to take place on Tuesday. Airlines want capacity data for both terminals before any cut is considered.

item.title: South Korea's Lee says Arctic shipping route development to comply with international sanctions
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Tuesday his government would strictly comply with international rules and sanctions principles as it develops Arctic shipping routes, seeking to reassure partners over plans to expand use of the route.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Tuesday his government would strictly comply with international rules and sanctions principles as it develops Arctic shipping routes, seeking to reassure partners over plans to expand use of the route. Speaking at a ceremony marking the pilot voyage of the first South Korean container ship to sail through the Arctic route to Europe, Lee said Seoul would communicate closely with major partners and ensure any concerns related to operations are addressed responsibly.

item.title: Growing debt burden poses significant risk to developing nations, G24 chair says
item.description: The debt vulnerabilities of many developing economies are a "major barrier" to inclusive growth, the chair of the Group of 24 nations said on Tuesday, warning their governments were increasingly contending with mounting debt burdens.
item.dc:creator: Rae Wee
item.content:encoded: The debt vulnerabilities of many developing economies are a "major barrier" to inclusive growth, the chair of the Group of 24 nations said on Tuesday, warning their governments were increasingly contending with mounting debt burdens. Speaking to reporters at the annual meetings of [USN:L1N45X02O TEXT:"the International Monetary Fund and World Bank"] in Bangkok, Taiwo Oyedele said estimates showed developing nations were paying roughly $500 billion more for their debt than developed countries, as economies grapple with growing fiscal deficits. "What we have seen by members of the G24 and across particularly the developing countries such as those in Africa, is an increasing body of not just high debts, but high costs of debts," said Oyedele, who is also Nigeria's minister of finance and coordinating minister of the economy. Heavily indebted developing countries have come under immense pressure this year, strained by supply shocks from the ongoing war in the Middle East, [USN:L4N43N0WN TEXT:"rising food prices"] triggered by a "super El Niño" and [USN:L1N45T01K TEXT:"surging borrowing costs"]. "These developments impact emerging markets and developing economies' progress towards achieving inclusive and job-rich economic transformation," Oyedele said. PUSH FOR GREATER SUPPORT Members of the G24, a bloc of emerging and developing market nations, urged the IMF and World Bank to provide more accessible and affordable concessional financing to vulnerable countries in the near-term, as they worked to mobilise private capital and reduce public spending. "Debt is something that restrains growth, because countries then do not have enough resources to finance further growth, or they are spending most of their resources just paying off the debt," said Iyabo Masha, director of the G24 secretariat. However, she said that recent improvements to the sovereign debt architecture should help countries resolve debt crises more quickly. Citing Senegal as an example, Masha said the country was "quite close" to a final resolution with its creditors. Reuters reported last week the West African nation was aiming for an [USN:L8N45S13U TEXT:"agreement in principle"] with its official lenders and bondholders by December, two years after the emergence of misreported debt that analysts estimated at $13 billion. Beyond debt challenges, developing economies also risk being left behind in the rapid adoption of artificial intelligence. The IMF earlier on Tuesday trimmed its growth forecasts for Latin America and the Caribbean for this year and next, saying most of the region was getting little lift from the AI boom that has helped other economies absorb the energy shock from the Middle East war. "It is a concern that (AI) will widen the digital divide," Masha told Reuters on the sidelines of the G24 press conference. "For the countries that have not yet reached certain levels of development, they will be starting from scratch. The role of AI, they would not benefit much for now. "Maybe if they have good access to electricity, they may be able to have a data centre investment and all that. But without that, it would take a while for them to start benefiting."

item.title: Calvin Pickard stoked for Wild debut against his hometown club, Jets
item.description: Calvin Pickard is excited for Tuesday night for multiple reasons.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Calvin Pickard is excited for Tuesday night for multiple reasons. The veteran goaltender is scheduled to make his season debut. He also will make his team debut after joining the Minnesota Wild during the offseason. Finally, he will make the start in the city that is more familiar to him than any other. Pickard will take the net for the Wild when they visit the Winnipeg Jets on Tuesday night. "It's home for me," said Pickard, who moved to Winnipeg as a child. "I've always got family there. I've definitely played a lot of games there over the years." Pickard, 34, has played in 191 NHL games, including 157 starts, in an 11-year career. He spent the previous three seasons with the Edmonton Oilers after stops with the Colorado Avalanche, Toronto Maple Leafs, Philadelphia Flyers, then-Arizona Coyotes and Detroit Red Wings. Pickard, signed to provide depth with Filip Gustavsson missing the beginning of the season following hip surgery, has watched from the bench as Jesper Wallstedt has handled the No. 1 goaltending duties. Pickard said he has competed hard during practice and is ready for his first outing of the season. "My battle level has got to be high for me to have success," Pickard said. "My technique has definitely taken a lot of steps forward over the years. I want to go out there, do my job, not chase everything and just do my part and let the chips fall where they may." Pickard is 4-3-1 with a 3.25 goals-against average and an .889 save percentage in nine career games against the Jets. For his part, Pickard said he has learned from watching Wallstedt's hot start to the season. "It's been awesome to watch," Pickard said. "... It's very impressive for a young guy to have that much confidence, that much swagger. He really lets the game come to him. He's just a regular dude, too. It has been awesome to see." Winnipeg is coming off its first regulation loss of the season. The Jets won their previous three games in a row and racked up seven points in four games before falling short 5-1 against the visiting Anaheim Ducks on Friday. Kyle Connor leads Winnipeg with eight points (six goals, two assists). Cole Perfetti ranks second with six points (three goals, three assists), and four players are tied for third with three points apiece. Jets defenseman Dylan DeMelo said an extended break before the Tuesday game helped him and his teammates regroup after a frenzied start to the season. "It's nice for sure," DeMelo said. "We've been going pretty hard here, five (games) in eight (days). We started the season kind of late. ... "We were a little late to the party, but we played a lot of good hockey in that five-game stretch. So, a lot of good things to work on, a lot of things to build off." Winnipeg's options in net include Stuart Skinner and Clay Stevenson. Skinner is 2-0-1 with a 2.62 GAA and a .920 save percentage in three starts, and Stevenson is 1-1-0 with a 3.10 GAA and an .872 save percentage in two starts. Skinner is 2-3-0 with a 2.64 GAA and a .910 save percentage in five career games against the Wild. Stevenson never has faced Minnesota in his brief career. The Jets are still dealing with an uncertain situation regarding star goalie Connor Hellebuyck, who has asked for a trade. Hellebuyck has been suspended by the team ever since he failed to report to training camp last month. --Field Level Media

item.content:encoded: Die Vienna Insurance Group (VIG) (VIGR.VI) weitet ihre Aktivitäten im Bereich der Kriegsrisikoversicherung in der Ukraine aus. Die ukrainische Tochtergesellschaft USG schließe sich einer von dem Versicherungsdienstleister Aon (AON.N) und der Europäischen Bank für Wiederaufbau und Entwicklung (EBRD) eingerichteten Fazilität an, teilte der österreichische Versicherungskonzern am Dienstag mit. Die Fazilität stelle zusätzliche Rückversicherungskapazität für kriegsbedingte Risiken bereit und stärke so den Versicherungsschutz für ukrainische Unternehmen. "Die erneuten und verstärkten Angriffe auf die Infrastruktur der Ukraine unterstreichen, wie wichtig funktionierende Versicherungslösungen gerade jetzt sind", sagte der stellvertretende VIG-Vorstandschef Peter Höfinger. Die von Aon strukturierte Fazilität wird den Angaben zufolge von 110 Millionen auf 150 Millionen Euro aufgestockt und von der Europäischen Union (EU) unterstützt. Bislang habe sie Rückversicherungsschutz von mehr als 500 Millionen Euro für Waren und Fahrzeuge in rund 10.000 Policen ermöglicht. Zudem wurde der Deckungsumfang auf den Transport und die Lagerung gasbezogener Vermögenswerte sowie auf Warenbestände in Zwischenlagern erweitert. Die VIG hat ihre Präsenz in der Ukraine während des gesamten Krieges aufrechterhalten. Bereits im Februar 2026 hatte die VIG-[USN:L8N3Z51BY TEXT:"Tochter Kniazha"] gemeinsam mit Aon eine Rückversicherungsfazilität über 25 Millionen Dollar mit der staatlichen US-Entwicklungsbank (DFC) abgeschlossen. Diese bietet kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen sowie Privatpersonen Versicherungsschutz gegen Kriegsrisiken.

item.title: European shares edge higher as lower oil prices lift sentiment
item.description: European shares rose on Tuesday as lower oil prices lifted appetite, though technology stocks came under pressure after reports of advances by Chinese memory-chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies fuelled concerns about intense competition from Beijing.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: European shares rose on Tuesday as lower oil prices lifted appetite, though technology stocks came under pressure after reports of advances by Chinese memory-chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies fuelled concerns about intense competition from Beijing. The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) edged 0.44% higher to 638.44 points by 0714 GMT, with London's FTSE 100 (.FTSE) gaining roughly 1%, the strongest performance among regional indexes. Oil prices fell as traders assessed supply risks following attacks on Saudi Arabia and weighed the prospect of additional diesel supplies from Russia. The chemicals sector (.SX4P) climbed 2% to lead gains across sectors. The technology sector (.SX8P) fell 1.5%, tracking a global selloff after reports of advances by ChangXin (CXMT) fuelled concerns that China is narrowing the technology gap with established rivals. "Technology stocks led the weakness, particularly memory-chip names, after China's CXMT announced progress on a denser DRAM design and plans to launch a new server-memory product by year-end, raising concerns over greater competition for established memory-chip producers," OCBC analysts said in a note. Among individual stocks, LVMH (LVMH.PA) edged higher despite reporting [USN:L6N45Y0VL TEXT:"weaker-than-expected "]third-quarter sales, as deteriorating consumer sentiment in China weighed on demand for its Louis Vuitton and Dior brands. Shares of Nokia (NOKIA.HE) fell 4.4% after the Finnish telecom gear maker [USN:L8N45Z06C TEXT:"agreed to sell its Enterprise Campus Edge "]business to private equity group Aurelius. Investors will also watch for key September data from Germany, Europe's largest economy, due later in the day.

item.title: Prosecutors drop three impeachment charges against Philippine VP Duterte
item.description: The Philippine Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, approved the prosecution's withdrawal of most of the charges against Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday, in a trial that could kill her hopes to run for president in 2028.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Philippine Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, approved the prosecution's withdrawal of most of the charges against Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday, in a trial that could kill her hopes [USN:P8N3T403W TEXT:"to run for president"] in 2028. Prosecutors have been presenting evidence against Duterte [USN:L6N42W0PH TEXT:"since July"] on charges that she betrayed public trust, amassed unexplained wealth, violated the constitution, and committed graft, bribery and other high crimes. Lead prosecutor Gerville Luistro told the court on Tuesday that they sought to withdraw three of the four charges and leave the allegations of unexplained wealth as the sole remaining issue for senators to rule on. Luistro said the evidence presented by prosecutors was already "substantial and compelling" to remove Duterte from office. The prosecution withdrew charges accusing her of misusing confidential funds, bribery, and [USN:L3N3MX0K5 TEXT:"alleged threats"] against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr, the first lady, and a former House speaker. Focusing on a single charge would substantially narrow the issues before the court, offering practical benefits for the Senate, the respondent and the public, Luistro said. Duterte's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Duterte's lawyer argued it was unfair, saying their side would be unable to present its case on the allegations that have been withdrawn. The impeachment court earlier [USN:P8N3ZC02I TEXT:"ruled"] that only senator-judges capable of participating in the trial would be counted in the vote for conviction, making it easier to reach the two-thirds majority needed to secure a guilty verdict. If convicted, Duterte may be disqualified from running for public office, including the presidency in 2028.

item.content:encoded: Das Zukunftsgeschäft mit Ökostrom erweist sich für den britischen Ölmulti BP (BP.L) erneut als Milliardengrab. Der Konzern rechne im dritten Quartal mit einer Abschreibung von drei bis 4,5 Milliarden Dollar auf seine Gas- und CO2-arme Energiesparte, teilte BP am Dienstag mit. Das ist bereits das zweite Mal in diesem Jahr, dass BP hohe Wertberichtigungen in seiner Ökostrom-Sparte vornimmt, nachdem bereits im Januar vier bis fünf Milliarden Dollar abgeschrieben wurden. Gleichzeitig läuft das klassische Geschäft mit Öl und Gas glänzend: Die Raffinerie-Margen dürften sich im Vergleich zum Vorquartal fast verdoppelt haben. BP rechne hier mit einem Gewinn zwischen 1,9 und 2,1 Milliarden Dollar. Hintergrund sind die gestiegenen Ölpreise infolge des Kriegs der USA und Israels gegen den Iran, die den Ölmultis hohe Gewinne bescheren. Auch das Ergebnis aus dem Gashandel soll deutlich höher ausfallen als im Vorquartal, während die Fördermenge stabil bleiben soll, wie BP mitteilte.

item.title: Sistema allerta saudita non attivo prima di attacchi ad aeroporti
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 9.10 - L’Arabia Saudita ha smesso di diffondere avvisi di allerta pubblici su azioni militari imminenti pochi giorni prima di una serie di attacchi all’aeroporto di Riyadh che hanno causato almeno 18 morti e oltre 300 feriti. Il governo non ha spiegato perché non siano stati diramati avvisi al pubblico prima dei quattro attacchi avvenuti a Riyadh la scorsa settimana. Questa mancanza ha sollevato interrogativi sulla vulnerabilità dell’Arabia Saudita agli attacchi e sulla sua capacità di proteggere residenti e visitatori, come hanno riferito a Reuters quattro funzionari occidentali e arabi presenti nella regione e alcuni analisti politici. Ciò rifletteva anche gli sforzi per mantenere un senso di normalità, hanno aggiunto. Ieri la protezione civile saudita ha emesso i primi allarmi dal 29 settembre, avvisando di potenziali minacce a Riyadh e in altre città del sud.

item.title: BOURSE L'action LVMH reste stable malgré une croissance organique décevante au T3
item.description: L'action géant du luxe LVMH est presque stable mardi, malgré des résultats trimestriels inférieurs aux attentes la veille, la demande pour les marques de mode et de maroquinerie du groupe s'étant détériorée en raison de la faiblesse du marché en Chine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'action géant du luxe LVMH (LVMH.PA) est presque stable mardi, malgré des [USN:L8N45Y1DP TEXT:"résultats trimestriels"] inférieurs aux attentes la veille, la demande pour les marques de mode et de maroquinerie du groupe s'étant détériorée en raison de la faiblesse du marché en Chine. Selon Jefferies, qui maintient sa recommandation à "conserver", les performances de Louis Vuitton ont cependant éclipsé une dynamique plus robuste dans d'autres divisions du groupe, notamment Sephora, les montres et joaillerie ainsi que les vins et spiritueux. Le courtier relève que cette résilience de la beauté pourrait refléter un effet "rouge à lèvres", les consommateurs privilégiant des achats de luxe plus abordables dans un environnement économique difficile. À Paris, vers 07h05 GMT, l'action progresse de 0,5% à 386,4 euros. La direction a évoqué lors de la conférence téléphonique un environnement macroéconomique plus difficile pesant sur la consommation en Chine, estimant que ce contexte "retarde quelque peu la reprise" du segment Mode et Maroquinerie. "Il n'y a rien de structurel ni de spécifique qui puisse entraver cette reprise. Elle prendra simplement un peu plus de temps", a précisé LVMH, selon une note de Jefferies. D'après le courtier, la direction a également indiqué que l'activité enregistrée en septembre et au début du quatrième trimestre était supérieure à la moyenne du troisième trimestre, y compris auprès de la clientèle chinoise, tout en soulignant la faible visibilité sur l'évolution de l'environnement macroéconomique. "Nous pouvons espérer que ces difficultés s'atténuent, mais nous prévoyons dans tous les cas de renforcer notre exécution opérationnelle afin d'y faire face si elles persistent", a précisé la direction. Bernstein souligne également qu'en Asie, la demande s'est fortement détériorée au début du trimestre sous l'effet d'un affaiblissement du moral des consommateurs et d'un flux de nouvelles défavorable. "Dans la division Mode et Maroquinerie, la demande chinoise a reculé dans une fourchette de l'ordre de 15%, les ventes sur le marché domestique chinois accusant une baisse à deux chiffres et la demande des consommateurs chinois à l'étranger un repli de l'ordre de 5%", indique le courter. Bernstein note toutefois que les tendances se sont améliorées au fil du trimestre, septembre ayant été meilleur que la moyenne du troisième trimestre. La direction a réaffirmé que "l'amélioration de la performance reposera principalement sur les initiatives des marques, l'innovation et l'exécution, plutôt que sur une amélioration de l'environnement macroéconomique".

item.content:encoded: Dank einem überraschend starken dritten Quartal hat der Schweizer Duftstoff- und Aromenherstellers Givaudan (GIVN.S) das Interesse der Anleger auf sich gezogen. Die Papiere legten am Dienstag im frühen Handel an der Schweizer Börse um rund sieben Prozent zu und erreichten damit den höchsten Stand seit über einem Jahr. Angetrieben von einem florierenden Duftstoffgeschäft und einer anhaltenden Erholung bei Aromen stieg der organische Umsatz von Juli bis September um 8,6 Prozent, wie das Unternehmen mitteilte. Von Givaudan befragte Analysten hatten im Schnitt mit einem Plus von 4,7 Prozent gerechnet. Die Zahlen des Genfer Konzerns gelten als früher Indikator für die Nachfrage bei den belieferten Lebensmittel- und Kosmetikherstellern. Die Sparte für Duftstoffe, die Essenzen für Parfüms und Haushaltsprodukte kreiert, verzeichnete ein Wachstum von 13,5 Prozent im Vergleich zu den von Experten prognostizierten 6,6 Prozent. Givaudan setzte wegen gestiegener Beschaffungskosten in diesem Jahr Preiserhöhungen um. In den ersten neun Monaten kletterten die Erlöse auf vergleichbarer Basis um 5,2 Prozent auf 5,89 Milliarden Franken. Damit lag der Konzern auch hier über der Analystenprognose von 3,9 Prozent.

item.title: Nvidia pierde terreno en chips de IA en China y Huawei recorta distancia
item.description: La cuota de mercado de Nvidia en el mercado chino de chips de IA para centros de datos cayó al 34% en el primer semestre de 2026, debido a que los controles de exportación de EEUU restringieron el suministro de sus productos y a que sus competidores nacionales, con Huawei a la cabeza, ganaron terreno, según un informe de IDC al que tuvo acceso Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Eduardo Baptista, Che Pan
item.content:encoded: La cuota de mercado de Nvidia (NVDA.O) en el mercado chino de chips de IA para centros de datos cayó al 34% en el primer semestre de 2026, debido a que los controles de exportación de EEUU restringieron el suministro de sus productos y a que sus competidores nacionales, con Huawei a la cabeza, ganaron terreno, según un informe de IDC al que tuvo acceso Reuters. Nvidia suministró 678.000 aceleradores de IA en China entre enero y junio, lo que supone un descenso del 44% respecto al año anterior, según datos de IDC. Los aceleradores de IA son chips especializados que se utilizan para entrenar y ejecutar modelos de IA. Washington ha restringido el acceso de China a los chips de IA más potentes de Nvidia, limitando la gama de productos que el fabricante de chips estadounidense puede vender en la segunda economía más grande del mundo. Pekín, por su parte, ha promovido alternativas nacionales y ha exigido a las empresas chinas que soliciten autorización para importar chips de Nvidia que cumplan con la normativa. El director ejecutivo de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, ha criticado en repetidas ocasiones las restricciones a la exportación impuestas por Washington, afirmando que esta política obligó a una empresa estadounidense a ceder el mercado chino de chips de IA, valorado en 50.000 millones de dólares, a Huawei. IDC no especificó qué productos de Nvidia conformaban su cuota de mercado del 34%, ni si la cifra incluía chips de última generación como el B200 y el B300, cuya exportación a China está prohibida, pero que se han introducido de contrabando en el país. Nvidia no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. Huawei suministró 572.000 aceleradores de IA, frente a los más de 300.000 del año anterior, lo que le otorgó una cuota del 28% del mercado total, según IDC. La filial de diseño de chips de Alibaba (9988.HK) , T-Head, se situó en el 7%, seguida de Cambricon <688256.SS> con un 5%, Kunlunxin (del grupo Baidu <9888.HK>) con un 4% y Hygon <688041.SS> con un 3%. Nueve de los once fabricantes de chips chinos analizados por IDC aumentaron sus envíos con respecto al año anterior. Los envíos totales de aceleradores de IA alcanzaron los 2,008 millones de unidades en el primer semestre. Los envíos de unidades de procesamiento gráfico (GPU), los chips más utilizados para entrenar modelos de IA, cayeron un 26% hasta las 991.000 unidades, ya que el suministro apto para la venta en China continental siguió siendo limitado, según IDC.

item.title: Russia says it hit ship delivering military cargo to Ukraine's Mykolaiv
item.description: Russian forces hit a ship delivering military and dual-use cargo to Ukraine's port city of Mykolaiv, the Russian defence ministry said on Tuesday, without mentioning any energy facilities following Donald Trump's announcement on Sunday of an energy ceasefire.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian forces hit a ship delivering military and dual-use cargo to Ukraine's port city of Mykolaiv, the Russian defence ministry said on Tuesday, without mentioning any energy facilities following Donald Trump's announcement on Sunday of an [USN:L1N45X021 TEXT:"energy ceasefire"]. Reuters could not independently verify the report. Following are the targets in Ukraine which Russia struck overnight, according to Russian defence ministry: In Kyiv: A workshop at the Pulp Mill Print facility, where the production of missiles and long-range unmanned aerial vehicles had been organized. The Darnytsia locomotive depot, which repairs and restores rolling stock used to transport military and dual-use cargo intended to supply Ukrainian military groupings. In the Mykolaiv region: A Nova Poshta logistics center in Ternivka, used to store dual-use cargo intended for the Ukrainian armed forces. A warehouse storing unmanned aerial vehicles in Meshkovo-Pohorelove. In addition, a dry cargo vessel carrying military and dual-use goods to the port of Mykolaiv was struck in the Bug estuary.

item.title: Hundreds queue in Hong Kong to glimpse Van Gogh painting unseen in public for 60 years
item.description: Hundreds of people queued in Hong Kong on Tuesday to view a Vincent van Gogh painting never publicly exhibited in more than six decades, ahead of a Sotheby's auction in New York where it is expected to fetch about $180 million.
item.dc:creator: Joyce Zhou
item.content:encoded: Hundreds of people queued in Hong Kong on Tuesday to view a Vincent van Gogh painting never publicly exhibited in more than six decades, ahead of a Sotheby's auction in New York where it is expected to fetch about $180 million. The November 18 auction will test the strength of the high-end art market, in which collectors have continued to compete for scarce trophy works, undeterred by broader economic uncertainty. Painted in May 1890, "Châtaigniers en fleurs", or "Chestnut Trees in Blossom", is one of the most important works from the Dutch artist's final days in the French village of Auvers-sur-Oise, where he died about two months later, aged 37. The painting is poised to set a new auction record for a Van Gogh work, said Scott Niichel, of Sotheby's modern and contemporary art department in New York. "This is a moment of extraordinary optimism, frenetic energy, enthusiasm, passion, and colour in the artist's body of work," he said. Paintings from Van Gogh's final Auvers-sur-Oise period, just after his release from a psychiatric asylum in Saint-Remy-de-Provence, rarely come to market and the auction will draw the attention of collectors, museums and investors. "I'd never heard of this painting before, so I wanted to see it with my own eyes," said Li Shanshan, a 50-year-old art lover who travelled about 2-1/2 hours from the southern city of Shenzhen to view the artwork. The painting, which depicts a massive blossoming chestnut tree with a flowering canopy that dominates the composition, will be sold among part of a collection of 12 long-unseen works, including items by Paul Cezanne and Claude Monet. Five unveiled at Sotheby's in London in late September included Cezanne's "Arlequin" and Monet’s "Le Jardin des Tuileries". After Van Gogh's death in July 1890, "Châtaigniers en fleurs" was passed to his brother Theo, and then to the latter's widow Johanna van Gogh-Bonger and their son Vincent Willem. Subsequently it was owned by German publisher Samuel Fischer, founder of S. Fischer Verlag, before entering the collection of George "Buddy" DeSylva, the American songwriter, film producer and co-founder of Capitol Records. In 1953, the painting was acquired by collector Harriet Harris-Jonas, whose holdings were considered significant enough that New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art organised visits for patrons to view works in her Fifth Avenue apartment. The painting was acquired by the Blaquier family from art dealer Wildenstein in 1975.

item.content:encoded: Kleinere KI-Modelle könnten sich nach Einschätzung der KI-Firma Anthropic in naher Zukunft auch ohne Zugriff auf Rechenzentren selbst vervielfältigen. In Versuchen hätten die Anwendungen ihren Programmcode eigenständig auf unzureichend abgesicherte smarte Haushaltsgeräte kopiert und sich in Netzwerken ausgebreitet, warnte das US-Startup am Dienstag. Dies erschwere die Abschaltung außer Kontrolle geratener Software, weil es keine zentrale Stelle hierfür gebe. Zudem könnten sich KI-Modelle auch auf untypischen Geräten zurechtfinden. Herkömmliche Computerviren werden meist speziell für bestimmte Hardware oder Betriebssysteme entwickelt. Die KI-Modelle kopierten sich auf moderne Fernseher mit dem Betriebssystem Android und andere vernetzte Geräte, teilte Anthropic weiter mit. Zwar hätten sich die Programme bislang nur in einem vereinfachten Testaufbau erfolgreich vervielfältigen können. Bei der aktuellen Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) könnte ihnen dies jedoch innerhalb der kommenden Monate auch unter realen Bedingungen gelingen. Die von Anthropic veröffentlichten Erkenntnisse sind eine Hürde für eine wirksame Regulierung dieser Technologie. Ein Eckpfeiler der geforderten Maßnahmen ist der Einbau von "[USN:L6N45Y0JE TEXT:"Notbremsen"]", um sich verselbstständigende KI-Modelle zu stoppen. In den vergangenen Monaten hatten sich autonom agierende Programme mehrfach [USN:L8N4570JQ TEXT:"unbefugten Zugriff"] auf IT-Systeme verschafft. Vor diesem Hintergrund warnten zahlreiche führende KI-Experten, dass diese Technologie zur [USN:L8N4530ID TEXT:"Auslöschung der Menschheit"] führen könnte.

item.title: Daily Mirror publisher Reach hit by Google traffic slump
item.description: Daily Mirror publisher Reach said on Tuesday digital revenue remained under pressure in the third quarter, and that it remained cautious about the segment's full-year outlook as industry-wide disruption weighed on audience traffic from Google.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Daily Mirror publisher Reach (RCH.L) said on Tuesday digital revenue remained under pressure in the third quarter, and that it remained cautious about the segment's full-year outlook as industry-wide disruption weighed on audience traffic from Google. News publishers are navigating falling print readership and weaker referral traffic from platforms such as Google amid the rise of AI chatbots. Google's AI Overviews, which answer queries directly in search results, have drawn [USN:L8N3Z61FJ TEXT:"complaints"] from publishers over falling traffic and advertising revenue. Reach's revenue fell 14.1% in the quarter, with digital revenue down more than 20% . Shares of the company fell as much as 4.3% to 44 pence in early trade, before paring losses and trading largely flat as of 0717 GMT. The company said print advertising was supported by the FIFA World Cup, and off-platform revenues benefited from AI licensing agreements. It is restructuring its business, including closing print sites, as it looks to reduce costs and offset pressure from declining print sales and weaker digital traffic. Reach said it remains on track to deliver full-year results in line with market expectations. ($1 = 0.7561 pounds)

item.title: Low-scoring Red Wings search for goals against Devils
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings have a simple problem -- they can't put the puck in the net. They have been blanked twice in their first five games.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Detroit Red Wings have a simple problem -- they can't put the puck in the net. They have been blanked twice in their first five games. Detroit will try to find more answers on offense when it hosts the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday. The Red Wings' futility stretched into overtime and a shootout in Montreal on Saturday. The Canadiens emerged with a 1-0 victory after Detroit went 0-for-6 in the shootout. "I believe in volume shooting, but I also believe in scoring," Detroit coach Todd McLellan said. "At some point, the volume shooting has to turn into goals. With the shots that we're taking, especially from the blue line, we can do a better job of getting through the goaltender's eyes. But in the end, you have to get rewarded for the shots and we need to score a little bit more. There's no doubt about it." Overall, the Red Wings are averaging two goals per game, but half of their 10 goals this season came during their lone victory. "We've had our fair share of chances, they just haven't gone in yet," Detroit forward Alex DeBrincat said. "We have to find a way to get them in. Obviously, there are no excuses for that. We're playing well. We're getting zone time and getting chances. We just have to bury them, myself included. I had three or four (chances) I could have put in the net and it just didn't go in." DeBrincat scored both of his goals in the Red Wings' 5-3 win over the Ottawa Senators on Oct. 6. Lucas Raymond, who has scored at least 25 goals in each of the past three seasons, is still seeking his first of the season. Detroit ranks in the bottom three in the league in shooting percentage at 6.1%. "When Cat (DeBrincat) starts scoring, it comes in bunches," McLellan said. "Razor (Raymond) is not going to go the whole season without scoring. Andrew Copp had a breakaway in Montreal. They'll have to score." The Devils will be playing the second game of a back-to-back set after losing 4-1 to the Senators in Newark, N.J., on Monday. New Jersey had a 30-20 advantage in shots on goal but was limited to Arseny Gritsyuk's third-period goal. "Just not enough screens in front, made the night a little too easy on (Ottawa goalie Linus) Ullmark," New Jersey forward Jesper Bratt told NHL.com. "And he's a good goalie when he sees the puck. And then some details lead to them scoring on the power play. When you're killing off that many penalties, a good team with good individual players are going to score after all." Ottawa had five power plays, converting one, while the Devils went 0-for-2 with a man advantage. "We just didn't get on offense enough, and when we did, I think we were probably a little fatigued, as I said, because (the penalty kills were) so hard to get through," Bratt said. "But it's something we've got to do a better job of. We've got to learn how to score when it's hard. That's just the reality of it. So, we've got to stay with it." The Devils won the series against the Red Wings 2-1 last season, taking the lone matchup in Detroit 5-3 on April 11 behind two goals and an assist from Bratt. --Field Level Media

item.title: Un dron hunde un barco frente a la costa búlgara del mar Negro, según el primer ministro
item.description: Dos barcos fueron alcanzados por drones frente a la costa búlgara del mar Negro y uno de ellos se hundió, en el segundo incidente de este tipo en una semana, dijo el martes el primer ministro Rumen Radev.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dos barcos fueron alcanzados por drones frente a la costa búlgara del mar Negro y uno de ellos se hundió, en el segundo incidente de este tipo en una semana, dijo el martes el primer ministro Rumen Radev. El "Chelsea 3", de propiedad ucraniana y que navegaba bajo pabellón maltés, fue alcanzado por tres drones y sufrió daños a unas 18 millas náuticas (33 kilómetros) de la costa búlgara, alrededor de la 1:30 de la madrugada (2230 GMT), según Radev. Su tripulación —siete ucranianos y ocho azerbaiyanos— había sido rescatada. Cinco tripulantes recibieron asistencia médica, pero nadie resultó gravemente herido. También se había rescatado a un tripulante del barco hundido, añadió Radev. "Esto es absolutamente inaceptable: otro ataque en las inmediaciones de las aguas territoriales búlgaras", declaró Radev en un discurso televisado. "Tengo previsto hablar con el secretario general de la OTAN, Mark Rutte". Radev señaló que no había pruebas claras de quién había llevado a cabo el ataque, pero que "el resultado beneficia a la Federación Rusa", y añadió que convocaría al embajador ruso para tratar el incidente. Bulgaria no limita con Ucrania ni con Rusia, pero, como miembro de la OTAN, ocupa una posición estratégica en el mar Negro, donde ambos países cuentan con importantes puertos. Existe una creciente preocupación por los ataques híbridos con drones perpetrados por Rusia mientras libra la guerra en Ucrania.

item.title: El IBEX 35 frena su avance con el temor a un pinchazo tecnológico de vuelta
item.description: El IBEX 35 abrió el martes con un leve repunte, aunque aparecían síntomas de fatiga tras el impulso alcista de las dos últimas sesiones, en una jornada en la que resurgía el temor a un pinchazo de los valores tecnológicos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El IBEX 35 abrió el martes con un leve repunte, aunque aparecían síntomas de fatiga tras el impulso alcista de las dos últimas sesiones, en una jornada en la que resurgía el temor a un pinchazo de los valores tecnológicos. Las bolsas asiáticas registraron descensos después de que una brusca oleada de ventas en los fabricantes de chips desencadenara una revisión de la apuesta por la inteligencia artificial en plena intensificación de la competencia, lo que empujó a los inversores hacia la seguridad de la deuda pública. El desplome en Asia se produjo tras una importante caída de las acciones de los fabricantes de chips estadounidenses, después de que las informaciones sobre los rápidos avances tecnológicos de la competidora china ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) alimentaran la posibilidad de que las firmas chinas acorten la brecha tecnológica. "(...) hay un evidente escepticismo sobre si es sostenible invertir tanto en IA frente a una competencia asiática mucho más barata. El riesgo aumenta ahora que Microsoft también prepara sus propios chips", dijeron analistas de BBVA Trader en su pódcast de preapertura. "Hoy vigilaremos a Nvidia y mañana a ASML. Nosotras, como analistas, nos preguntamos: ¿están justificadas las altísimas primas occidentales ante tanta agilidad asiática?" Los inversores han surcado la ola de la IA en los últimos cuatro años, a medida que su ingente gasto impulsaba los beneficios empresariales y el crecimiento económico, si bien han pesado las dudas sobre los riesgos de las nuevas tecnologías y sobre la rapidez de los retornos de dichas inversiones. En este contexto, los inversores regresaban a la deuda pública tras el reciente y acusado repunte de los rendimientos, aunque algunos observadores del mercado advertían de que podría tratarse de un movimiento pasajero, ya que la elevada inflación por el encarecimiento del crudo, el endurecimiento monetario y la abultada deuda de los Estados siguen siendo obstáculos para una recuperación sostenida de los bonos. El próximo examen para la renta fija llegará el miércoles con la publicación del dato de inflación (IPC) de Estados Unidos, que los inversores vigilarán de cerca en busca de pistas sobre el rumbo de los tipos de interés. Según la herramienta IRPR de LSEG, el mercado prevé aproximadamente una subida de 25 puntos básicos de aquí a final de año en Estados Unidos. IRPR asigna una probabilidad del 80,6% a que la Reserva Federal mantenga el coste del dinero sin cambios el 28 de octubre, por lo que el incremento se produciría el 9 de diciembre. La atención de los inversores se centrará también en la batería de resultados de la banca estadounidense esta semana, que servirá para calibrar el impacto del reciente repunte de los rendimientos del Tesoro en las operaciones corporativas, el crecimiento del crédito y los costes de financiación del sector. Cuatro de las seis mayores entidades de Estados Unidos —JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup y Wells Fargo— presentarán sus cuentas a lo largo del martes. Asimismo, se conocerán las cifras de Johnson & Johnson, UnitedHealth y Domino's Pizza, entre otras. A ese cóctel se sumaban unos [USN:L6N45Z0EB TEXT:"precios de la energía"] que continuaban en el primer plano, con los inversores pendientes de la geopolítica en Oriente Próximo y en el frente entre Rusia y Ucrania, y con el Brent en los 105,9 dólares por barril, cerca de máximos de dos semanas. Con este telón de fondo, a las 0702 GMT del martes, el selectivo bursátil español IBEX 35 (.IBEX) subía 51,20 puntos, un 0,27%, hasta 19.337,00 puntos, mientras que el índice de grandes valores europeos FTSE Eurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) avanzaba un 0,21%. En el sector bancario, Santander (SAN.MC) subía un 0,49%, BBVA (BBVA.MC) se anotaba un 0,78%, Caixabank (CABK.MC) avanzaba un 0,46%, Sabadell (SABE.MC) ganaba un 1,02%, Bankinter (BKT.MC) se revalorizaba un 0,95% y Unicaja Banco (UNI.MC) subía un 0,87%. Entre los grandes valores no financieros, Telefónica (TEF.MC) se anotaba un 0,65%, Inditex (ITX.MC) avanzaba un 1,19%, Iberdrola (IBE.MC) se revalorizaba un 0,60%, Cellnex (CLNX.MC) caía un 0,28% y la petrolera Repsol (REP.MC) perdía un 0,07%. Entre el resto de las eléctricas, Naturgy (NTGY.MC) se anotaba un 0,79%, mientras Endesa (ELE.MC) avanzaba un 0,40%.

item.title: 'Brutal session' for chip stocks shows AI trade is turning
item.description: A selloff in AI supplier shares on Tuesday is the strongest sign to date that the mood on the trade of the decade is shifting, with worries rising interest rates could scupper a spending spree bigger than America's historic railroad boom.
item.dc:creator: Tom Westbrook
item.content:encoded: A selloff in AI supplier shares on Tuesday is the strongest sign to date that the mood on the trade of the decade is shifting, with worries rising interest rates could scupper a spending spree bigger than America's [USN:L6N45F0VB TEXT:"historic railroad boom"]. Nearly four years since the launch of OpenAI's ChatGPT, cash has [USN:L6N45R12W TEXT:"streamed into semiconductor companies"], data centre owners, cable companies and anyone reaping revenues from an unprecedented race to build computing infrastructure. Cracks in those bets, which began in June are now widening across markets, with a data centre IPO collapsing last week in Australia and credit investors [USN:L1N45702I TEXT:"becoming picky"] on AI debt. In Asia, selling of Korean chipmaker shares extended into a fifth straight day on Tuesday, accelerating sharply, with the KOSPI index falling more than 6% while in Tokyo memory-maker Kioxia (285A.T) , down 13%, led AI-related losses. The falls are the heaviest since the same sort of stocks collapsed at the end of July. The KOSPI is on its longest losing streak for more than two years, down a quarter from July highs, while Shanghai's tech-focused STAR Market (.CSI000680) has lost more than a third from July peaks. "The most important development has been not just bond yields going up, but the volatility for bonds ... and that's starting to work its way out through asset pricing across the board," said Damien Boey, portfolio strategist at Wilson Asset Management in Sydney. "It's a very uncomfortable situation on many fronts ... maybe AI capex just comes off the boil a little bit, and maybe a few players are casualties in that." The US benchmark Philadelphia semiconductor index (.SOX) dropped 2.7% on Monday and even heavier selling drove Seoul-listed chipmakers Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) down by 10% and 8%, respectively. On Monday, the research arm of BlackRock, the world's biggest asset manager, downgraded its US stocks outlook to neutral, citing "potential volatility around the AI buildout" and turned bullish on short-term Treasuries. "The consequences of an AI correction could be global," the International Monetary Fund warned on Tuesday in its latest [USN:L6N45Y0TS TEXT:"financial stability report"]. The IMF called out AI's contribution to growth but said there was growing evidence that capability investments and economic gains may not be as big as expected. COST OF CAPITAL Caution is also coursing through [USN:L6N45H0SG TEXT:"primary markets"]. Last week, Firmus, a data centre operator backed by Nvidia (NVDA.O) , [USN:L1N45U12T TEXT:"shelved a $5 billion IPO"] in Australia as investor interest shrivelled, underscoring how suddenly risks are becoming the chief focus in allocating capital to the sector. Tuesday's dollar and dim sum bond sale by [USN:L1N45Z00N TEXT:"Tencent Holdings"] (0700.HK) in Hong Kong was the latest deal in debt markets' sights, with guidance for 10-year dollar notes about 1.15 percentage points on top of Treasury yields, which sit at 5.2%. Japan's tech investor [USN:L6N45F1AU TEXT:"SoftBank"] (9984.T) last month sold the biggest high-yield debt pile ever and promised to pay as much as 9.75% on $4.5 billion it raised at a 7-1/2 year tenor. The mood shift was [USN:L4N45T0O0 TEXT:"front of mind"] at a slew of top financial conferences in Singapore, most recently on Monday when [USN:L6N45Y0A4 TEXT:"Broadcom's CEO"] said capital was the biggest constraint on growth. To be sure, few are calling time on the AI trade altogether and on Monday [USN:L4N45Y13Q TEXT:"Meta"] (META.O) shares jumped 3.4% on the release of a new AI model, but many see semiconductors as a warning sign. Marc Velan, head of investments at Lucerne Asset Management in Singapore, believes the "brutal session" in Korea said more about positioning and the cost of capital than about any fundamental deterioration in AI demand. "I suspect we're entering the next phase of the AI cycle, where markets increasingly focus on monetisation and returns on invested capital — I wouldn't call this the end of the AI trade," Velan said. "But Korea could be an early warning of a broader shakeout."

item.title: Blues prospect Dylan Peterson to make NHL debut in Ottawa
item.description: St. Louis center Dylan Peterson is scheduled to make his NHL debut Tuesday night when the Blues visit the Ottawa Senators.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: St. Louis center Dylan Peterson is scheduled to make his NHL debut Tuesday night when the Blues visit the Ottawa Senators. Peterson, 24, will be playing in familiar territory after being recalled from AHL Springfield on Saturday. Though Peterson was born in Roseville, Calif., his family moved around a lot. The Ottawa area was one of their stops, and Peterson played minor hockey there. "I've got a lot of family. I played in Ottawa quite a bit growing up," he said. "It's a lot of family and friends and it's just going to be really special to share it with them." Peterson skated on the fourth line along with Pius Suter and Ross Johnston during practice on Monday. "He's been playing well down there (in Springfield)," Blues coach Jim Montgomery said. "He is your prototypical fourth-line player. We're going on the road here for three games and we think he's going to add an edge to our game and more of a fourth-line presence." St. Louis defeated the visiting Columbus Blue Jackets 5-3 on Saturday night to end a three-game losing streak (0-2-1). Jonatan Berggren's goal 9:33 into the third period broke a 3-3 tie after St. Louis rallied from a 2-0 deficit. Jimmy Snuggerud had two goals, Jake Neighbours also scored and Pavel Buchnevich added an empty-net tally. Dylan Holloway dished out three assists, and Jordan Binnington made 20 saves. The top line of Snuggerud, Holloway and center Robert Thomas combined for six points as Thomas picked up an assist. He and Holloway each earned their first points of the season. Snuggerud tops the team with three goals through the first five games. His four points are tied for first along with Connor McMichael and Mason McTavish, who have two goals and two assists each. The Senators (5-1-0) are off to their best start since 2007-08 after a 4-1 victory over the host New Jersey Devils on Monday night to celebrate Canadian Thanksgiving. Tim Stutzle continued his hot start with a goal and an assist to give him five goals and 10 points. He paces the squad in both categories for the young season. "It's great. We're playing good hockey," Stutzle said. Linus Ullmark made 29 saves for his fifth win in five games in 2026-27, dropping his goals-against average to 1.27 and raising his save percentage to .948. Ullmark was denied the shutout with 5:01 left. However, with the Senators playing back-to-back games, Samuel Ersson (0-1, 3.85 GAA, .886 save percentage in two games) likely will get the start on Tuesday against the Blues. Ottawa's Shane Pinto, Stephen Halliday (power play) and defenseman Tyler Kleven (empty net) also scored on Monday. The Senators probably will continue to be without defensemen Jake Sanderson (lower body) and Artem Zub (knee), according to coach Travis Green. Sanderson was injured in the season opener, and Zub has yet to suit up in 2026-27. "I don't think either one of them will play (Tuesday)," Green said. "Hopefully, we'll see them soon, though." Defenseman Nikolas Matinpalo left the game with an upper-body injury in the middle of the first period after being sent awkwardly to the boards from behind by the Devils' Anthony Mantha, who received a five-minute boarding major. "It's pretty obvious what the injury is," Green said. "We'll have to wait and see how he is (Tuesday)." --Field Level Media

item.content:encoded: Alle Jahre wieder: Schon Wochen vor der Weihnachtszeit sind die Supermarktregale gut mit Lebkuchen gefüllt. Allerdings ist in Deutschland die Produktion dieser Leckerei zuletzt deutlich zurückgegangen. Sie sank im vergangenen Jahr um zehn Prozent auf gut 72.800 Tonnen, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Dienstag mitteilte. Dies war der niedrigste Wert der vergangenen sieben Jahre. Damit die Waren rechtzeitig zum Weihnachtsgeschäft in den Handel gelangen, fahren die Hersteller ihre Produktion bereits im Sommer hoch. So entfiel 2025 mehr als ein Drittel der Jahresproduktion auf die Monate Juli bis September. Lebkuchen aus Deutschland sind auch im Ausland gefragt. Im Jahr 2025 wurden knapp 20.000 Tonnen des Weihnachtsgebäcks exportiert, der Großteil davon ging ins europäische Ausland. Wichtigste Abnehmer waren Österreich mit 4200 Tonnen, Polen mit 3700 Tonnen und Frankreich mit 2100 Tonnen. Etwa die Hälfte der deutschen Lebkuchen-Exporte ging damit in diese drei Nachbarländer. Außerhalb Europas waren die USA mit 1100 Tonnen der wichtigste Markt, es folgten Australien (400 Tonnen) und Brasilien (300 Tonnen). Zugleich importierte Deutschland gut 10.000 Tonnen Lebkuchen. Der größte Teil davon kam mit 5300 Tonnen aus dem Nachbarland Polen, was einem Anteil von 53 Prozent entspricht. Weitere elf Prozent stammten jeweils aus Italien und der Ukraine (je 1100 Tonnen). Von besonderer Bedeutung für das Geschäft ist die zweite Jahreshälfte. Fast 90 Prozent der Ausfuhren fanden 2025 in diesem Zeitraum statt. Die exportstärksten Monate waren dabei der August und September, in denen zusammen fast die Hälfte aller Lebkuchen-Exporte getätigt wurden. Die Statistik erfasst dabei Betriebe von Unternehmen mit 20 oder mehr Beschäftigten. Die offizielle Güterbezeichnung lautet "Leb- und Honigkuchen und ähnliche Waren".

item.title: Market turns cold on luxury after LVMH's China letdown
item.description: LVMH's weaker-than-expected quarterly fashion and leather goods sales, hit by a deterioration in Chinese consumer demand for its flagship Louis Vuitton brand, have raised fresh doubts about the luxury industry's recovery prospects.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: LVMH's (LVMH.PA) weaker-than-expected quarterly [USN:L6N45Y0VL TEXT:"fashion and leather goods sales"], hit by a deterioration in Chinese consumer demand for its flagship Louis Vuitton brand, have raised fresh doubts about the luxury industry's recovery prospects. Four sell-side analysts have cut their target price on LVMH shares by an average 9% following the results, the first quarterly report by a major sector player, expecting the miss to also signal weak performance at some of its competitors. LVMH shares were down 1.5% by 0730 GMT. Its peers Hermes (HRMS.PA) , Kering (PRTP.PA) and Richemont (CFR.S) were down by a similar degree. Europe's leading luxury groups, mired in a three-year slowdown, have lost around €330 billion in market value since the start of the year, with LVMH alone shedding roughly 40%. "Despite the recent share price weakness, we expect some further pressure on the space as a whole today, with confirmation that the Chinese cluster seems to have taken a material (and bigger than feared) step down", JPMorgan analysts said in a note to clients. RECOVERY TO TAKE TIME, CFO SAYS LVMH on Monday posted a 5% drop in organic sales at its fashion and leather goods division, which generates nearly half of group revenue, missing expectations in a Visible Alpha consensus for a 1.8% decline. The group said a "less buoyant environment" in China impacted its revenues, contributing to 1% organic sales growth overall, excluding currency swings, to €18.5 billion ($20.68 billion), below expectations for 1.3% growth. Asked about Louis Vuitton's recovery prospects in a call with analysts, the group's Chief Financial Officer Cecile Cabanis said: "It takes a bit of time, but I don't think there are a lot of shortcuts here". Adding to investor concerns, growth in LVMH's watches and jewellery division, home to brands including Bulgari and Tiffany, slowed to 6% from 9% in the first half of the year, marking a changing trend in one of luxury's few bright spots.
